description: Add new social features to the app. As a social media app like Instagram/Twitter/Snapchat, add: (1) A proper loading/splash screen component with the Parallax logo and animated loading indicator to replace the plain black screen, with a 5-second timeout fallback that redirects to /auth. (2) Enhanced Feed with pull-to-refresh gesture. (3) Story viewing improvements with progress bar and tap navigation.
steps: Create a new AppLoadingScreen component at src/components/layout/AppLoadingScreen.tsx with animated Parallax logo, pulse animation, a 'Loading...' text, and gradient background matching the dark theme (bg-[#050505])
Add a 5-second timeout in the loading screen that redirects to /auth if auth state hasn't resolved
Replace the basic Loader2 spinner in src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx with the new AppLoadingScreen
Update the Suspense fallback in src/App.tsx to use AppLoadingScreen instead of null/empty
Add pull-to-refresh support to Feed.tsx using a touch gesture handler (onTouchStart/Move/End pattern) that triggers the existing refresh() function
Add story progress bar component to show viewing progress on stories (src/components/social/StoryProgressBar.tsx)
Update index.css or create loading keyframes for the splash animation
acceptance_criteria: Loading screen shows Parallax branding with animation instead of plain black/spinner
After 5 seconds of loading, user is redirected to /auth as a fallback
Feed supports pull-to-refresh gesture on mobile
Story progress bar shows which story segment is active
App builds successfully with `bun run build`
verification: Run `bun run build` to confirm Vite build passes
Run `bun run test -- --run` to confirm tests pass
Run `bunx tsc --noEmit` to confirm type safety
